correction: The rule shipped at /usr/lib/user-tmpfiles.d never ran: systemd-tmpfiles --user reads only XDG config and data directories. Delete it, not move it: a per-user policy would hide the system policy's Frostyard signature checks and later changes.
evidence: https://github.com/frostyard/snosi/issues/1265: tmpfiles.d(5) v262 user paths exclude /usr/lib/user-tmpfiles.d; src/tmpfiles/tmpfiles.c user_config_paths() uses user_search_dirs in v262 and xdg_user_dirs in v245. On a live Snow host, systemd-tmpfiles --user --cat-config lists no /usr/lib path and ~/.config/containers is absent.
